Hi Jane / Tom —

Congrats again on the signature. Attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan focused on embedding Redwood into your production path (tech transfer, canary, migration, training). I wanted to capture a pragmatic timeline and owners so we can lock on dates and avoid last-minute rushes. Key proposed milestones: 

- Tech transfer (knowledge handoff, access, secrets, infra prep): week of Sep 28 — owners: Karthik (Redwood), Chorus infra lead
- Canary window (limited traffic + observability): Oct 5–12 (3 full days of live traffic + 4 days of monitoring) — owners: Ben (Redwood ops), Chorus SRE
- Migration cut (traffic shift + rollback window): Oct 19–23 — owners: Marissa & Chorus PM
- Training waves (admin + user ops + runbooks): Oct 26–Nov 6 — owners: Ben (ops), Chorus enablement
- Evaluation plan: acceptance criteria include 99th pct latency < 600ms for p50/p95 targets, error rate < 0.1%, quality regression on eval prompt set within tolerance (A/B tests to baseline).

Deliverables attached: Chorus_MAP_v1.xlsx and canary-checklist-v1.pdf. Please review feasibility of the windows above and flag any constraints (org holidays, blackout dates, compliance approvals). If the timeline works we’ll circulate a detailed day-by-day runbook and calendar invites.

Questions for you:
- Are there any mandated blackout windows in Oct/Nov?
- Do you want a minimal canary footprint (synthetic traffic only) or an initial slice of live traffic?

Goal: get final MAP by next Friday (2026-09-24) so engineering and SRE can reserve capacity.

Thanks —
Olga

Jane — thanks for the heads up. We can accommodate an earlier canary with the following compromise that limits risk while keeping schedule tight: 

Proposal:
- Oct 1–3: synthetic canary (load sims + smoke tests) on a dedicated canary pool (no live traffic).
- Oct 4–6: limited live slice (<=5% traffic, feature-flagged, full observability).
- Oct 8–12: surge soak testing (scale up to predicted peak for 48 hours, then taper). Because Oct 12 is a compliance blackout for you, we’ll avoid any final cut activity that day — the surge can complete by Oct 11 end-of-day.

Action owners / quick commitments:
- Canary orchestration: Ben Carter (redwood) — will provide canary automation repo and rollback scripts.
- Rollback trigger + on-call execution: Chorus SRE (Tom Wu) + Redwood escalation contact (Ben) — we will add play definitions to the runbook.
- Token rotation: Karthik Iyer to produce a short checklist itemizing any secrets work; we’ll confirm whether changes are required.

I’ve added these as comments in the HubSpot deal and created a skeleton canary-test-plan in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cChorusMAP. If that sequence works for you we’ll produce Chorus_MAP_v2.xlsx with the updated dates and a versioned test plan by EOD Sep 17.
